page.notes: The "β" at the foot of the right column is a gathering mark and is given as signature. Left-margin fragments are show-through from the facing page and are omitted. The number "4" beside the entry "pastorem" and the stray "4" by "di" at the right column top are printed as shown or treated as marginal bleed; the line "Da omni petenti te, di" is printed with its "di" continuing into "cti sensus quis" and is read as one line.
